remarks: Location, Location, Location! Wonderful Bettswood Ranch convenient (within 5-10 minutes) to: schools, shopping, beaches, train station (walkable), parks, Golf, Highways, museums, and much more. Situated at end of quiet, low-traffic street on .31 acre lot with large, private, partially-fenced yard. Patio off Kitchen allows for enjoyable family/friend gatherings and meals. Inside, Living Rm w/ FPL, Formal Dining Room, Primary Bedroom with full bath, 2 other bedrooms, office (has closet and is a possible 4th Bedroom) - all with Hardwood Floors, Full heated unfinished basement with wet bar, roughed-in 1/2 bath and exit to backyard. Walkup attic offers expansion possibilities. Attached 1-Car Garage w/ access from back patio/back door from kitchen (door to garage is locked; you can look thru windows in front garage door. Generator included and City Water/Sewer. This can be your Dream Home!
